title: Question 7
passage:
Do we have clearance to send the first batch to the paint shop this afternoon?
A. The paint booth is free after lunch. B. Only if the inspector signs off before two. C. The last job came back from the paint shop this morning.
passageZh:
第一批零件獲准在今天下午送去噴漆區了嗎？
A. 噴漆室午餐後就空了。
B. 只有檢驗員在兩點前簽核才可以。
C. 上一筆工單的零件今天早上已從噴漆區送回來了。
audioScript:

A. The paint booth is free after lunch. B. Only if the inspector signs off before two. C. The last job came back from the paint shop this morning.
